insights.title: Post-inflammatory erythema
insights.summary: Flat red marks can persist after inflammation; they are not necessarily active acne.
mechanisms: Residual superficial vascular changes can follow inflammation.
Barrier irritation can prolong visible redness.
contributing_factors: Picking and friction can sustain inflammation.
UV exposure and over-exfoliation can worsen recovery.
zone_notes: Right cheek: phone contact, pillowcase friction and irritating products may contribute; these are possibilities, not a diagnosis.
insights.see_a_professional: Seek advice for persistent or worsening redness, pain, or recurring flushing that could suggest rosacea.

insights.title: Inflammatory acne
insights.summary: Tracked raised inflammatory features may be compatible with acne; the camera cannot confirm a diagnosis.
mechanisms: Sebum and follicular hyperkeratinisation can block pilosebaceous follicles.
Cutibacterium (formerly Propionibacterium) acnes and immune inflammation contribute to inflamed lesions.
contributing_factors: Occlusive products and repeated friction can worsen susceptible skin.
Androgen sensitivity and genetic predisposition can contribute; hygiene alone does not explain acne.
zone_notes: Left cheek: phone contact, pillowcase friction and irritating products may contribute; these are possibilities, not a diagnosis.
Chin/jawline: follicles can be androgen-sensitive; hormonal influence is possible but cannot be inferred from location alone.
insights.see_a_professional: Seek a dermatologist for painful nodules or cysts, scarring, or persistent acne.

insights.title: Hyperpigmentation
insights.summary: Uneven darker areas can follow inflammation or sun exposure; a camera cannot distinguish benign spots from concerning lesions.
mechanisms: Inflammation may stimulate excess melanin production.
UV exposure can increase melanin and prolong discoloration.
contributing_factors: Picking or irritating treatments can leave persistent pigment changes.
Sun exposure and hormonal influences may contribute; appearance alone cannot establish the cause.
zone_notes: Forehead: hair products, fringe occlusion and headwear can contribute to irritation or follicular blockage; location alone does not establish a cause.
insights.see_a_professional: Changing or irregular pigmented spots need prompt assessment: ABCDE means asymmetry, border irregularity, color variation, diameter and evolution; melanoma can also be small.

ingredients.name: Azelaic acid
ingredients.rationale: Post-inflammatory erythema: May support acne-related marks; redness response varies.; Inflammatory acne: Supports acne and residual marks.; Hyperpigmentation: Helps post-inflammatory uneven tone.
cautions: Temporary stinging can occur; start slowly.
Introduce one new active at a time and stop if persistent irritation occurs.

ingredients.name: Broad-spectrum sunscreen SPF 30+
ingredients.rationale: Post-inflammatory erythema: Limits UV-related discoloration during recovery.; Hyperpigmentation: Limits UV-driven darkening.
cautions: Apply generously and reapply per label; patch test sensitive skin.
Introduce one new active at a time and stop if persistent irritation occurs.

ingredients.name: Niacinamide
ingredients.rationale: Post-inflammatory erythema: Supports barrier recovery.; Inflammatory acne: Supports the barrier during acne care.; Hyperpigmentation: May reduce uneven pigmentation.
cautions: High concentrations can sting sensitive skin.
Introduce one new active at a time and stop if persistent irritation occurs.

ingredients.name: Benzoyl peroxide
ingredients.rationale: Inflammatory acne: Targets inflammatory acne-associated bacteria.
cautions: May irritate skin and bleach fabrics.
Introduce one new active at a time and stop if persistent irritation occurs.

ingredients.name: Salicylic acid (BHA)
cautions: May dry or sting; avoid with salicylate allergy.
Introduce one new active at a time and stop if persistent irritation occurs.

ingredients.name: Adapalene
ingredients.rationale: Inflammatory acne: Helps prevent blocked follicles.
cautions: Avoid in pregnancy or when planning pregnancy; introduce gradually.
Introduce one new active at a time and stop if persistent irritation occurs.
